versions.changelog:
xhs-note-detail-guaikei v1.0.0

- Initial release of skill for retrieving and analyzing public Xiaohongshu (小红书) content.
- Supports four major scenarios: note search, note detail, comment analysis, and author works monitoring.
- Command-line operations based on clear user tasks and link/keyword recognition.
- Provides structured error handling, clear parameter documentation, and platform-specific guidance.
- Requires Node.js 16.14.0+ and GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable for API access.
